title: bundling_report
description: One report of lobbyist bundled contributions (Form 3L) a committee filed, from the FEC's lobbyist bundling file (from 2010): contributions registered lobbyists and lobbyist PACs bundled to a campaign, party committee or leadership PAC. Amendments are rows too, marked `is_superseded`. Sum `amount`, never `period_amount` or `semi_annual_amount`. Every bundled gift is already an individual's contribution, so never add these amounts to `contribution` or any receipt amount. No row names a bundler or a donor. Partitioned by cycle.

cycle.description: The two-year election cycle, named by its even year: the coverage end's year, rounded up to even; with no coverage end, the receipt date's.

source.description: Where the row comes from. `fec` for every row of v1.

jurisdiction.description: The regulator whose rules and ids the row follows. `US` (the FEC) for every row of v1.

committee_id.description: The FEC id of the committee the contributions were bundled to.

receipt_date.description: The date the FEC received the report.

coverage_start.description: The first day the report covers; null when the filer gave none.

coverage_end.description: The last day the report covers; null when the filer gave none.

half_year.description: The half-year the coverage end falls in, `<yyyy>-1` (January to June) or `<yyyy>-2` (July to December); null with no coverage end.

period_amount.description: The amount bundled in the report's covered period, as filed. Never sum it: a report covering six months repeats its quarters.

semi_annual_amount.description: The amount bundled in the half-year, as filed. Never sum it: it repeats the half's period amounts.

is_superseded.description: True when a later report of the same committee and covered period (latest receipt date, then higher image number) replaces it.

amount.description: What the report adds to its committee's bundled total. Per committee and half-year these sum to the greater of the half-year amount and the period amounts of the reports that hold no other; a superseded report, or one with no coverage end, adds 0. Sum this.
